verdict.rationale: Linear's rate-limiting docs publish exact per-auth API limits, leaky-bucket refill, complexity limits and rate-limit response headers, and say higher limits can be requested from support. That implies throttling rather than overage charges for API calls. Separately, admins can set spend limits for agent usage, but no evidence says what happens when those limits are reached. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of the behavior when limits are exceeded (error code or hard block versus extra charges), what happens when Loops or agent spend limits are hit, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits

citations.quote: API key — 2,500 requests per User per 1 hour; OAuth App — 5,000 per User; Unauthenticated — 600 per IP Address
If you temporarily require higher limits, you can request them by contacting Linear support where we'll review them on a case by case basis.
Admins can also set workspace-wide and per-user spend limits that reset daily, weekly, or monthly.
